description: Full prediction record per match: the crowd’s home/draw/away shares (live while the round is open) and the expert cohort (expert.outcome, from the Friday 18:00 Europe/Berlin deadline; expert.criteria says how the cohort was chosen). Pass an id (e.g. "classic:btm:7:14") for one match, or mode/status filters for a list. outcome is null while fewer than minCohort (20) players have picked.

mode.description: Restrict to one game mode; omit for all.

status.description: Restrict to one match status; omit for all.

name: get_consensus
title: Get match consensus
